title: Chapter 694 - 694 Breakthrough; Planet Level!
content:
Chapter 694 - 694 Breakthrough; Planet Level!

Chapter 694 - 694 Breakthrough; Planet Level!

694 Breakthrough; Planet Level!

For the rest of the time, Lin Fan and Ma Zhong did not bring the Spiritual Pearls toward the east where they could enter the core region of the Heavenly Wind World.

Instead, they continued to kill exotic beasts in the outer area.

…

Time flowed like water. In the blink of an eye, Lin Fan had been in the Heavenly Wind World for almost a year.

A dazzling sword light swept across the sky and instantly cut a cheetah that was more than ten meters tall in the distance into two halves.

Then, a tall and handsome figure slowly walked out.

It was Lin Fan.

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-four Planet beast. You’ve obtained 40,000 experience points.]

Then, he turned his attention to the system.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Star Traveller Level 9 (8.96 million/10 million)]

[Skills: Sword 81 (Mortal), Curse (Emperor), Sword Nurturing Technique (Emperor), Cosmos Sword Technique (Emperor)]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Ordinary Rank), Flame Armor (Emperor Rank), Heavenly Soul Pearl (Emperor Rank), True Dragon Sword (Emperor Rank)]

[Laws: Time (elementary), Space (intermediate), Metal (elementary), Wood (elementary), Water (elementary), Fire (intermediate), Earth (elementary)]

[Character Relationship:

[Lin Tao: Daddy; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Dai Weixue: Mom; Favorability:Ten stars]

[Lin Xiaoyao: Sister; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Xue: Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Bing, Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan muttered in his heart, ‘I haven’t broken through to the Planet level yet. This is slower than I thought.’

Slow?

If others knew about Lin Fan’s situation, they would definitely be shocked.

One had to know…

Every time a Star Traveller broke through a small realm, it would take at least a few hundred years.

Lin Fan’s speed was simply unbelievable!

At this moment, Lin Fan heard another notification in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve obtained the advanced system for one year. Reward: 1,000,000 experience points, Thunder Battle Axe (Emperor) x1, 18 Thunder Axe (Emperor) x1, Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem x1.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s expression changed slightly.

Advanced system?

Could it be the upgraded system?

He had possessed it for a year and received a reward.

Would he receive a reward every year in the future?

At the thought of this, Lin Fan’s eyes burned with passion.

Whether it was experience points, weapons, cultivation techniques, or leveling gems, they were all very good things.

If he could obtain these treasures every year, why would he have to worry about not being able to protect Earth and his family?

Not far away, a beast’s roar sounded.

Lin Fan did not even look and just waved his sword.

A ferocious wolf fell to the ground.

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-five Star Traveller mutated beast. You’ve obtained 50,000 experience points.]

[Ding! Your cultivation level has increased to the first level of the Planet Realm (1/5000).]

[Ding! You’ve completed the hidden mission. Your cultivation has increased to the Planet level. You’ve obtained Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem x1, Defense Array (Emperor), Flame Spear Art (Emperor), and Soul Communication (Emperor).]

A surge of energy spread out from Lin Fan’s body, forming a strong hurricane around him. The trees rustled, and the leaves flew everywhere.

At the same time, a complicated formation, a powerful spear technique, and a mysterious soul technique rippled in his mind.

Ma Zheng, who was at the side, could feel Lin Fan’s powerful aura and could not help but gulp.

He was secretly shocked. Just how strong was Senior Lin?

[Ding! Ma Zheng’s favorability toward you has increased to six stars.]

In this one year, Ma Zheng had been admiring Lin Fan, and his impression of him kept increasing.

Lin Fan casually glanced at Ma Zheng and said, “Let’s go to the front and rest for a while.”

“Alright… Alright,” Ma Zheng hurriedly said.

Lin Fan sat down under the tree and closed his eyes to rest. His attention was focused on the two Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem. He wanted to choose the time and metal laws.

However, the time law was still in a gray state, and the metal law was flickering.

[Hint: The time law is a special law. It can only be upgraded after more than ten laws have been upgraded to intermediate or above.]

[Do you want to use the Beginner Rule Upgrade Gems for the gold and wood laws?]

“Yes!”

The two streams of light revolved around Lin Fan and entered his body.

Lin Fan immediately felt that he had a deep understanding and closeness towards the metal and wood elements.

Creating metal and trees out of thin air was a piece of cake.

Following that, Lin Fan focused his attention on Soul Communication.

[Soul Communication: A magical power that allows you to easily communicate with people you’ve seen or come into contact with across distance and space.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up immediately.

This was simply an interstellar phone!

He hurriedly established a Soul Communication with Lin Tao.

Soon, Lin Tao’s consciousness appeared in a dark space.

“What is this place?” he asked, somewhat confused.

“Could it be a dream?”

Then, Lin Fan appeared.

“Dad!”

“Could it be that I haven’t seen Lil Fan for too long?” Lin Tao muttered.

Lin Fan smiled. “Dad, you’re not dreaming. This is an ability I just learned. I can ignore space and talk to you directly.”

“Really?” Lin Tao said in surprise.

“Yes.” Lin Fan nodded. “How are you guys doing on Earth?”

“Good, good! We’re all fine!” Lin Tao said excitedly.

Clearly, he believed Lin Fan’s words.

Then, Lin Fan told Lin Tao about the recent events.

Then, he communicated with Dai Weixue, Lin Xiaoyao, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Hu Tian, Han Tian, Su Ningjing, and all his loved ones.

Although they could not meet each other, everyone felt much more relaxed after chatting.

After communicating, Lin Fan’s desire to increase his cultivation grew even more fervent.

Only with enough strength could he better protect his beautiful life.

Hence, Lin Fan brought Ma Zheng along and started hunting beasts.

In the blink of an eye, five years had passed.

In the past five years, Lin Fan had received a reward from the system every year. He had received 37 million experience points, as well as Heaven Flipping Palm (Emperor), Heaven Stabbing Finger (Emperor), Black Jade Whip (Emperor), Heaven Breaking Whip (Emperor), Heaven Climbing Pine (Emperor), and many other treasures.

In the past five years, Lin Fan had lost count of how many strange beasts he had killed. He had also killed some foes. Finally, his cultivation state had reached level-three Planet.

On this day, Lin Fan stood at the peak of the mountain and looked down at the layers of trees below. “There are still four years left. It’s about time to go to the core area to take a look.”

Then, he said to Ma Zheng, “Let’s go to the east.”

“You mean…” Ma Zheng’s heart moved slightly.

“We’re going to the core area,” Lin Fan said.

“Yes, sir!” Ma Zheng said excitedly.

All these years, Ma Zheng had relied on Lin Fan and obtained many benefits.

At the same time, he had a deep understanding of how invincible Lin Fan was.

Ma Zheng believed that as long as they entered the core region, Lin Fan would definitely be able to obtain more opportunities.

He would also benefit from it.
